title: Roger Yap earns first Cesafi win as head coach

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Roger Yap finally got his first taste of victory as a Cesafi head coach as the University of San Jose-Recoletos (USJ-R) Jaguars unleashed a dominant performance to maul the University of Cebu Lapu-Lapu and Mandaue (UCLM) Webmasters, 75-46, in the Cesafi Season 26 men’s basketball tournament on Thursday night, Sept. 17, at the Cebu Coliseum. It was a milestone victory for the retired PBA star, who is now calling the shots for his alma mater, as the Jaguars snapped a two-game losing skid to open their campaign and finally entered the winning column.
